Still, he raised his hand and kept the light burning.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市还没有醒。路灯把空荡的街道照得发白，清洁车缓缓驶过，刷子擦出细碎的声响。便利店亮着灯，店员隔着玻璃望向路口。一辆出租车停下，又很快开走。天边渐渐透出浅蓝，早班的面包师推开店门，温热的香气飘进微凉的风里。","w03":"- Recursion means solving a problem by doing a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Imagine opening a box and finding a smaller box inside, then another smaller box.\n- You need a stopping rule: when you reach the last box, you stop opening boxes."}
